name: build-label
description: Build label: the Firmware screen (Setup Menu, Firmware) shows 'Body : 1.6  EPM2Mod YYYY.MM.DD', the 'label' of the build description; epm2mod make writes it over the placeholder 0000.00.00 (src/epm2mod/label.py). The version number is not changed (block 0 header +16 = 0x1600, prm tag 0xC082). Byte edits, no new code: the panel's object grows so that its value text holds 48 characters; the Body line formats with its own text, in unreferenced debug strings of segment 2; the four value texts (Body, Lens, Flash, Acc) are left-aligned in wider boxes that start at one x, so they line up as in stock. See experiments/2026-11-19-build-label/NOTES.md.

ops._note: panel 99 (Firmware screen) object: 936 -> 1024 bytes; its last field (+928) is the value text, which grows from 4 to 48 UTF-16 characters
panel 99, line 0 (Body): the format text 0x7EBB2FEC instead of the shared L"%X.%X"
panel 99, widgets 10-13 (the Body, Lens, Flash and Acc values), both copies of each rectangle: x 369 w 100 -> x 337 w 335 (640-wide coordinates, screen x = x + 40); a box clips its text
panel 99, widget 10 (the Body value): alignment 0x101 (centred) -> 0x100 (left, as the labels), so that the four values start at one x
panel 99, widget 11 (the Lens value): alignment 0x101 (centred) -> 0x100 (left, as the labels), so that the four values start at one x
panel 99, widget 12 (the Flash value): alignment 0x101 (centred) -> 0x100 (left, as the labels), so that the four values start at one x
panel 99, widget 13 (the Acc value): alignment 0x101 (centred) -> 0x100 (left, as the labels), so that the four values start at one x
the Body line's format text L"%X.%X  EPM2Mod YYYY.MM.DD" in unreferenced Bluetooth debug strings (reclaim-space row 2); epm2mod make writes the build's label in place of 0000.00.00
